chain.title: Leavings of the Restless
chain.desc: Hunt Wraiths at night or loot dungeon chests for Ectoplasm, the spectral residue that every dark craft begins with.

chain.title: Roots of Power
chain.desc: Craft a Totem of Roots from an Ectoplasm, two lapis and three sticks, then carry it while killing mobs to charge it with Soul Energy.

chain.title: A Vessel for Spells
chain.desc: Surround a charged Totem with four amethyst shards to craft four Empty Focuses, the blank cores every spell is built on.

chain.title: The Pointing Begins
chain.desc: Combine an Empty Focus, two lapis, Magic Fabric and a plank into a Dark Wand; slot a Focus into it (default Z key) to cast spells with Soul Energy.

chain.title: First Incantation
chain.desc: Craft a Soul Light Focus, a cheap starter spell that hurls a projectile leaving a glowing ball of light where it lands.

chain.title: The Lapis Siphon
chain.desc: Craft a Cursed Infuser from lapis, a coal block, stone bricks and a cauldron; it siphons magical energy into items placed on top of it.

chain.title: Secrets of the Illagers
chain.desc: Infuse an ordinary emerald on the Cursed Infuser to awaken it into a Magic Emerald, the gem behind Illager artifice.

chain.title: A Deeper Well
chain.desc: Craft a Totem of Souls from two Magic Emeralds, gold, lapis and a soul lantern; it holds far more Soul Energy than your root totem.

chain.title: Profaned Metal
chain.desc: Fuse iron and gold with two mob remains (bones, string, gunpowder or rotten flesh) over a charged Totem to forge two Cursed Ingots, the spawner-metal.

chain.title: Caging Souls
chain.desc: Craft a Cursed Cage from eight Cursed Bars; insert a filled Totem so it can feed Soul Energy to the artifices around it.

chain.title: The Altar Awakens
chain.desc: Craft a Dark Altar from Magic Emeralds, shade stone and a pedestal, and set it atop a powered Cursed Cage - rituals only need the right blocks and items within its 8-block radius.

chain.title: The Animated Series
chain.desc: Perform an Animation Ritual on an Empty Focus with a minecart, a boat, leather and a feather to create Animation Cores, then use them to raise Zombie and Skeleton Servants.

chain.title: Dress Like an Evoker
chain.desc: Craft the Dark Robe and Hat: the hat cuts casting time while the robe cuts Soul Energy costs on every spell.

chain.title: Remote Connection
chain.desc: Forge-ritual a recovery compass, Soul Emerald, respawn anchor, ender pearl, dark prismarine, lodestone and obsidian into an Arca - a near-unbreakable block that stores and beams your Soul Energy so you can drop the totem.

chain.title: Fire Burn and Cauldron Bubble
chain.desc: Weld seven Cursed Ingots into a Witch Cauldron and brew custom multi-effect Witch's Brews powered by Soul Energy.

chain.title: Green Fire Below
chain.desc: Ritual-infuse a Shade Brazier with a Cursed Infuser, Magic Emerald, sculk catalyst, candle, Ectoplasm and three mob skulls; the Necrotic Brazier only burns inside the Deep Dark, atop a powered Cursed Cage.

chain.title: Dark, Darker, Yet Darker
chain.desc: Feed the Necrotic Brazier a Cursed Ingot, sculk and a ghast tear (2000 Soul Energy) to smelt a Dark Alloy Ingot.

chain.title: Forged in Darkness
chain.desc: Forge Dark armor from Dark Alloy Ingots through altar rituals - a full suit is the strongest garb a mortal necromancer can wear.

chain.title: The Late Healer's Regalia
chain.desc: Craft the Necro Staff through a Necroturgy ritual; paired with the Necro Crown and Cape, non-boss undead turn neutral and your necromantic spells grow stronger.

chain.title: The Witch of the Bog
chain.desc: Track down the Blighted Shack and slay the Crone, the ancient brewer within - her hat is one of the four relics of the Sabbath.

chain.title: Charred Overseer
chain.desc: Defeat a Wither Necromancer in the Nether fortress; its Withered Manuscript can be ritual-restored into the Bygone Scroll that unlocks Nether magic.

chain.title: Words That Burn
chain.desc: Ritual-bind a book with crying obsidian, Magic Emeralds, a blaze rod, a ghast tear and an Updraft Focus into the Infernal Tome, the last relic needed to call the Apostle.

chain.title: Judgement Day
chain.desc: Build the Sabbath circle (8 crying obsidian, 16 obsidian, 4 soul fires), offer the Crone Hat, Malefic Helm, Warlock Sash and Infernal Tome, activate with a netherite ingot - then kill the Apostle it summons. Never do this in the Nether, where it is strongest.

chain.title: King of the Dead
chain.desc: Restore the Forbidden Scroll, then perform the Master Necroturgy Ritual - Apostle's blood, a villager sacrifice and 1000 Soul Energy - to brew the Potion of Transformation; drink it under a full moon to become a Lich.

notes: Chain derived from the jar's own advancement tree (data/goety/advancements/goety/, 404 files: root -> totem_of_roots -> cursed_ingot -> cursed_cage -> dark_altar; empty_focus -> dark_wand -> focuses; crone -> summon_apostle -> apostle rewards; forbidden scroll -> become_lich), its recipes (ritual/brazier/infuser JSON) and the in-jar Patchouli 'black_book'.
